answer: Every new identity begins its voyage at the shallow edge of a shale-stratified ledger: its first earnings flow into a sealed oasis reserve and mature one stratum per settlement cycle, spendable only after three clean rounds. During probation, any second identity built on the same registration fingerprint is fused to the original - the sealed reserve of both burns on first detection, so each fake identity costs an attacker the entire locked balance it fronted, while honest identities pay nothing but time.
